newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia hikes internal coffee price.
newsitem.headline: Colombia hikes internal coffee price.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 11 Reuter - Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation raised the country's internal coffee price by 0.8 percent to 342,750 pesos per 125-kg load, a spokesman said.
The new price, up from 339,875 pesos set on April 4, was based on an average international price of $2.03 per pound of coffee in New York, the spokesman said.

The federation has now raised the internal coffee price eight times since Jan. 31. The price has been cut twice in the same time period, since the federation introduced a new sliding scale formula to calculate the domestic price paid to growers.
